chapterFiles.title: Videvdad 2 — Yima, the evil winters, and the Vara

versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: The Avestan law against the demons — Fargard 2: Yima, the evil winters, and the vara

descriptions.en: Fargard 2 of the Vidēvdād translated from the Avestan: Ahura Mazda offers Yima the Religion, gives him rule instead, warns him of the evil winters, and instructs him to build the Vara, an enclosure that keeps the seeds of people, animals, plants and fires. Source: romanized Avestan text after Geldner (1896, public domain) via avesta.org; Darmesteter (Sacred Books of the East 4, 1898) as reference.
